correctness.rationale: Under exact Lorits–Gubar Table 1 v(y)=4+3y,c(y)=12-2y, the clipped payoff h satisfies -1<=h<=49/68, so saturation reduces to sign-dependent positive part. Behavior x'=x(1-x)(v-cx)/2, opinion y'=(1-y)[h]_+ - y[-h]_+, resource n'=n(1-n)(3x-1). The behavior nullcline x=v/c meets h=0 once at Q=(1/2,1/2); on trapping strip 1/3<=x<=7/10 two boundary sinks P0=(1/3,0),P1=(7/10,1), and Q saddle with Jacobian [[-11/8,1/2],[0,15/32]]. Planar index eliminates cycles and saddle loops; Poincare–Bendixson gives global convergence in the strip. Convexity and h(x,1/2)=-11(2x-1)^2/16 force the one-sided y<=1/2 low-basin rule. Stable graph invariance with h<0 yields 44/103 quadratic curvature; logistic resource integrates exactly, giving path-dependent n_infty in low basin and n->1 elsewhere. Independent symbolic check confirmed Jacobian and curvature; finite trajectories alone are not global proof.
